Name: Multiple Mini-Obelisks
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
Allows you to place multiple mini-obelisks and rename them!

[b]Install[/b]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install this mod.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.


[b]Configurations[/b]
After running the game once with the mod installed, you will see a [b]config.json[/b] under the [b]...\MultipleMiniObelisks\MultipleMiniObelisks[/b] folder.

It contains the following option(s):
[list]
[*][b]AllowMiniObelisksToBePlacedAnywhere [/b]| If set to True, it will allow mini-obelisks to be placed anywhere. | Default: False
[/list]
